subject: Kestrel renewal - competitive bakeoff & ops safeguard
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir@kestrel.ai>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@kestrel.ai
Date: 2027-09-01T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal discussion + upcoming bakeoff

Irene / Marissa,

Quick heads up — our renewal for the core inference contract is coming up in Oct. We're exploring a competing vendor who offered a 2-week bakeoff to prove cost and latency improvements. We value Redwood's reliability, but the execs want fresh numbers.

Can Redwood run a benchmark/PoC that mirrors our QPS profile and a scoped capacity uplift (from 4 -> 8 GPUs) for two weeks? We also need SLOs and an ops runbook for canary failover.

I've attached a short RFP/POC scope so you can see constraints. Procurement will push timelines if we pursue the bakeoff. Let me know availability to kick off.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Rao
Head of ML Infrastructure, Kestrel AI
[Attachment: kestrel_poc_scope.pdf (PDF)]

From: irene_choi@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-01T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal discussion + upcoming bakeoff

Marissa / Ben / Karthik — FYI. Samir just flagged a bakeoff with a competitor and a potential capacity uplift request. This is classic churn risk territory but salvageable if we move fast.

Immediate asks:
- Draft a tight PoC scope aligned to their perf/CPO targets (Samir attached their doc).
- Offer a short-term uplift (8 GPUs) and a defined canary + rollback plan.
- Prepare pricing play: short-term uplift + committed term option vs. trial rates.

Marissa, can you own the PoC checklist? Ben, start a pricing sketch including a limited credit. Karthik, please surface any redlines we should expect from procurement.

I can join the kickoff call tomorrow afternoon.

Irene Choi
Sr. Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0182

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: irene_choi@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-02T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal discussion + upcoming bakeoff

Thanks — taking point on the technical scope. Draft attached: benchmark-checklist.xlsx. High-level plan below:

1) Baseline day (2 days): run their production traces against current prod model (no infra changes) to baseline latency/throughput.
2) Uplift week 1: provision 4->8 GPUs, enable prefix/KV caching for hot routes, run stress matrix at target seq lengths.
3) Uplift week 2: run mixed workloads, introduce continuous batching + cold-start runs.
4) Failover test (24h): simulate 20% region outage and validate automatic fallback to smaller quantized variant.

Ops deliverables: canary checklist, runbook for model swap, monitoring dashboards with token-level cost, and a rollback script.

Attachments: benchmark-checklist.xlsx (checklist + metrics), kestrel_poc_scope.pdf (their doc).

Questions: do we want to offer a short credit (1 month free for uplift) or reduce committed rate? My recommendation: 15% credit on uplift for the trial, with committed-term pricing contingent on passing perf gates.

–Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Solutions Engineering — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: benchmark-checklist.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@kestrel.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: Samir Rao <samir@kestrel.ai>, procurement@kestrel.ai
Date: 2027-09-03T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion + upcoming bakeoff

Marissa — this looks good. A few clarifications from our side:
- Procurement wants a clear statement of SLOs (p95 latency, error budget) and a 48h escalation path.
- The competitor has proposed a faster start date (next Monday). We can be flexible but need Redwood's test harness and a concise runbook by EOD Friday to sign off.
- SOC2 excerpt attached; we need to ensure any trial infrastructure meets our compliance boundaries.

We are willing to run the bakeoff, but the execs expect either a short-term TCO delta that favors Redwood or a path to parity with rollout commitments.

Elaine Park
VP, Product Operations — Kestrel AI
[Attachment: SOC2_AICPA_redacted.pdf (PDF)]

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Samir Rao <samir@kestrel.ai>, Elaine Park <elaine.park@kestrel.ai>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-07T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed terms + timeline (deal RWF-2027-KST-332)

Samir / Elaine — appreciate the quick turnaround. Attached is a proposed_terms_redwood_v2.docx that outlines:
- 2-week uplift trial (8 GPUs) starting 2027-09-13, scope per Marissa's checklist.
- Trial credit: 15% on uplift costs; committed 12-month renewal option with a 10% committed discount if signed within 30 days post-trial.
- SLOs: p95 latency target 120ms, error budget 0.5%. 48h on-call escalation to Redwood infra lead.
- Ops commitments: canary runbook, automated rollback, and a short training session for their SREs.

Links: DocuSign draft (https://docusign.redwood.com/rwf-kst-332), HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/123456789).

If that matches expectations, we'll lock resources and start the kick-off on Monday.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Exec — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proposed_terms_redwood_v2.docx (DOCX)]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: irene_choi@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: Samir Rao <samir@kestrel.ai>, Elaine Park <elaine.park@kestrel.ai>
Date: 2027-09-12T16:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed terms + timeline (deal RWF-2027-KST-332)

All — quick internal note before kickoff: a couple of procurement redlines likely (data retention clause, indemnity cap). I'll draft fallback language and a pre-approved escalation to Solutions+Legal if they push a different SLA. Also prepping a capacity uplift template we can push into provisioning to avoid a slow start.

Operational guardrails to include during the trial:
- Auto-fallback to q4-quant model if p95 > 200ms for 10m window.
- Telemetry hooks to capture token-level cost for each route (so finance can compare TCO).
- A short 30m SRE sync on day 0 and a post-trial findings doc.

I'll circulate the templates and loop Legal if procurement raises clauses outside the redlined set.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Customer Success — Redwood Inference
